text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото successfully finishes her
debut—but
pushes herself to the limit
doing so, collapsing
shortly after.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A shocking truth is revealed at the
infirmary.
Мэйсё Дото has yet to enter
her race-ready
state.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The race-ready state is an Umamusume's
period
of growth, so it's understandable
that
prematurely exerting herself would
have this
effect.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite the revelation, Мэйсё Дото
can't find it
in her heart to give up.
Slowly but surely, we'll
build up her
racing experience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
